name: Meiga, Lobismuller
body:
Lobismuller
CR 6

This mature female humanoid is garbed in once-fine raiment now worn and patched, along with skillfully stitched animal pelts. Her eyes glow a wolfish yellow in a cold, calculating gaze.

XP 2,400
N Medium fey (extraplanar)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., fear sense, low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +4 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 75 (10d6+40)
Fort +7, Ref +11, Will +9
DR 10/silver; Immune mind-affecting, sleep; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +11 (1d4+5/19–20 plus 4d6 force) or bite +10 (2d6+5 plus 1d6 force), 2 claws +10 (1d8+5 plus 1d6 force)
Special Attacks horrid howl
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +12)

At will—disguise self
3/day—fear (DC 16)
1/day—dream

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 19, Con 18, Int 11, Wis 14, Cha 14
Base Atk +5; CMB +10; CMD 25
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Spring Attack
Skills Climb +13, Intimidate +12, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +17, Survival +12, Swim +13
Languages Common, Sylvan; telepathy 30 ft.
SQ change shape (wolf–humanoid hybrid, beast shape I)
Gear mwk studded leather, mwk dagger

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Change Shape (Su)

When in hybrid shape, a lobismuller loses her gear. She gains a +4 natural armor bonus (AC 19, flat-footed 14), can make bite and claw attacks, and can use horrid howl.

She can’t make bite and claw attacks when in her true form.

Fear Sense (Su)

A lobismuller can detect a creature with the shaken, frightened, or panicked condition within 60 feet as if she had scent.

Horrid Howl (Su)

When a lobismuller is in its hybrid form, she can emit a terrifying howl as a standard action once every 1d4 rounds. Each creature within a 60-foot-radius burst takes 5d6 sonic damage (DC 17 Will save halves). A creature that failed its save is also frightened for 1d6 rounds. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pair, or troupe (3-6)
Treasure standard

The lobismuller delivers nightmares to the mortal minds that wander into the Land of Dreams. This is not done from malice, as nightmares are as natural to mortals as pleasant dreams. A lobismuller can transform into a sinister, wolf-like figure, ferocious and deadly. Those spellcasters that summon fey for their mortal purposes often choose a lobismuller for their more deadly form. A lobismuller usually appears as a mature woman in colorful clothing, though frayed and worn in spots. When on the hunt, she may adopt more primitive garb of animal skins befitting her inner wolfish nature.
